note: Independent re-audit against RFC 8050 Sections 2, 3 and 5.1 at HEAD. OnBGPMessage, updateAddPath, messageAS4, bgp4mpTypeSubtypeFor, and localSubtype (internal/plugins/mrt/component.go, dump.go) select all four ADD-PATH subtypes (8, 9, 10, 11) vs base subtypes (1, 4, 6, 7) from per-direction/per-family encoding context delivered via reactor wire observers (observeReceivedWire, observedBGPWriter.observe -> complete). TestRFC8050BGP4MPAddPathAS2Subtypes covers ASN4=false ADD-PATH IPv4/IPv6 (subtypes 8/10 vs 1/6) across BGP4MP and BGP4MP_ET. TestRFC8050MessageCallbackPreservesEncodingAndFraming covers ASN4=true (subtypes 9/11 vs 4/7) across BGP4MP/BGP4MP_ET, both directions, all four NLRI locations, and cross-family isolation. TestMRTWinningCollisionPreservesOPEN proves live TCP collision handoff preserves exact directional OPEN context and subtypes 9/11 vs 4/7 for isolated and mixed UPDATEs.
